title: Acquirer: QBE Insurance Group Ltd; Target: trade credit business of CGU Insurance Australia Ltd
targets: trade credit business of CGU Insurance Australia Ltd

body_sections.Summary: QBE proposed to acquire CGU's trade credit insurance portfolio
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 26 March 2002 the Commission advised QBE that it would not intervene in the proposed acquisition.  There are a number of alternative Australian and overseas competitors including EFIC/Gerling, AIG, Gerling/NCM and Dexta/Coface that could readily respond to any attempted exercise of market power by the merged firm.  Accordingly, the Commission considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition.
